subject.title: fix(gateway): session workspace reveal hangs on foreground opener

question: Should the repository adopt this PR's shared `open-path` lifecycle for both `config.openFile` and `sessions.files.reveal`, or keep the configuration-specific owner proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109126?
rationale: Both branches are active, proof-positive attempts at the same launcher-hang class, but they establish conflicting ownership boundaries; the repository policy favors one canonical path and this choice cannot be safely inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt the shared lifecycle
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical path because the shared helper already serves both affected Gateway callers, then resolve the overlapping configuration-specific proposal separately.

options.title: Keep lifecycle config-specific
options.body: Prefer the narrower configuration-owned implementation only if session-workspace reveal should intentionally retain its existing launcher behavior.

options.title: Request a consolidated successor
options.body: Ask for one rebased PR that preserves the selected ownership boundary and subsumes the useful proof from both branches.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared lifecycle
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical path because the shared helper already serves both affected Gateway callers, then resolve the overlapping configuration-specific proposal separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment and recent main integration make steipete the clearest available owner for choosing between the two active designs.
